**An Unforgettable Experience with LuxVac Tours & Travels!**

I recently embarked on the 5 Nights 6 Days tour covering Guwahati, Shillong, Cherrapunjee, Dawki, and Mawlynnong with LuxVac Tours & Travels, and it was nothing short of spectacular! From the moment we landed in Guwahati, the team ensured a seamless and comfortable experience.

The itinerary was well-planned, offering a perfect blend of natural beauty, cultural exploration, and adventure. Shillong, with its serene landscapes and pleasant weather, was a delight. Cherrapunjee’s lush greenery and majestic waterfalls, especially the iconic Nohkalikai Falls, left us in awe. The crystal-clear waters of Dawki and the cleanest village in Asia, Mawlynnong, were absolute highlights of the trip.

The accommodations provided were comfortable and well-located, and the food was delicious, with a mix of local and continental cuisines. Our guide was knowledgeable, friendly, and went out of their way to make the trip memorable.

A special shout-out to our driver, who was exceptional! He was not only skilled and cautious on the winding roads of Meghalaya but also very polite, punctual, and accommodating. He ensured our safety and comfort throughout the journey, making the ride smooth and enjoyable. His knowledge of the local routes and willingness to go the extra mile truly added to the overall experience.

LuxVac Tours & Travels truly exceeded my expectations. Their attention to detail, professionalism, and commitment to customer satisfaction made this trip unforgettable. I highly recommend this tour package to anyone looking to explore the beauty of Northeast India.
